references.text: Both verses illustrate Joseph's strategic treatment of Benjamin to test the brothers' loyalty and reveal their changed attitudes.
Verse 44:2 gives the direct instruction that leads to the discovery of the cup in Benjamin's sack described in the source verse.
Both verses emphasize Joseph's special treatment of Benjamin as a sign of restoration and brotherhood.
The dramatic climax of the source verse builds on the love for Benjamin expressed in this verse.
The test in the source verse leads directly to the reunion and confirmation of identity described in this verse.
